product_summary: Website rielta.in (footer: '© Rielta Security International Private Limited', phone +917666717477, sales@rielta.in) presents the company as a developer/manufacturer of security alarm systems and components since 1993, '300+ original designs'. Real catalogue lines read: Detectors (passive infrared Foton-9/10/15 series, glass-break, vibration/seismic Shoroh-5, combined PIR+glass-break, detectors with video camera, pet-immune up to 40 kg); Control panels / object security devices (Ladoga UOO-A versions 1-6, VUPS-K); Wireless products and 'RiDom' smart-home system (Ri-HUB-1i, Ri-MD-1i, Ri-MGBD-1i, Ri-DO-1i, Ri-TD-1i, Ri-THD-1i); Explosion-proof detectors; Security fog generator; Sensors and warning devices (DZ-3V, DZ-4, DZ-12V flood detectors, STZ/STZ-RK temperature sensors, Celsius-RK, Counter-RK, Udar-STG, SH2 passenger-flow sensor); IR sensors; Water shut-off systems; Addressable detectors; Other equipment. About page: 'We create security alarm systems since 1993', 100% quality control, 20+ patents, 5-year warranty.

comment: HS mismatch: declared codes 852329 (magnetic media), 854110 (diodes), 854149 (photosensitive semiconductor devices), 854231 (electronic integrated circuits/processors) describe electronic components, not finished security equipment. The company's actual catalogue is finished security-alarm hardware, which belongs primarily in 8531 (alarm devices) and 8531 90 (parts), with 8543 70 for the fog generator and special-function detectors. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds - verdict accepted_hs_corrected; the declared codes should be replaced by the actual 8531/8543 lines. Industry label 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification: this is security/anti-intrusion alarm equipment (electrical apparatus), not IT. Trader signs: the site is a brand site with cart/checkout, 'Become a Partner' and 'On request' pricing, and the entity name mirrors the Russian Rielta brand - a distribution/import role alongside manufacturing is plausible, but no public page states whether goods are produced in India or imported. Product lines missing from the declaration: complete alarm systems, control panels, wireless smart-home kits, explosion-proof detectors, fog generators, water shut-off systems, flood/temperature/passenger-flow sensors - none of these are covered by the declared component codes. All product data is from the company's own website (rielta.in/catalog, /about) and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line was available in this task to corroborate any code. No registry, revenue or shipment data was researched per role scope; PAN/CIN/state not public on the pages read (null).
